_comment: Cursor MCP config for the BullAlert API. Put this in .cursor/mcp.json in your project (or ~/.cursor/mcp.json globally), replace YOUR_BULLALERT_API_KEY with a key from https://bullalert.ai/dashboard (Account -> API), then reload Cursor and enable the 'bullalert' server in Settings -> MCP. Exposes 4 tools: list_watchlist, list_signals, list_alerts, get_company_financials. Informational data tool, not financial advice.
